name: APA student membership
summary: Free Australian Physiotherapy Association membership for students in accredited physiotherapy degrees.
key: Student membership is free for those studying an Australian Physiotherapy Council accredited physiotherapy degree.
who: Active student in an accredited, entry-level Australian physiotherapy degree (separate first-year and later-year categories)
how: Join as M7 (second year or later) or M7a (first year) on the APA site.

evidence.quote: Student membership is free for those studying an Australian Physiotherapy Council accredited physiotherapy degree.
This category doesn't include professional indemnity insurance (PII).
